key_insight: Among the detonation-sprayed WC coatings studied, WC–Co–Cr delivered the best combined hardness, friction, scratch resistance, and corrosion performance.
engineering_relevance: WC–Co–Cr coatings could extend the service life of pipeline valves and other oil-and-gas components exposed to wear and corrosion.
method: Detonation-sprayed WC coatings with Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr binders.
Characterized microstructure and composition using SEM and EDS mapping.
Evaluated microhardness, tribology, scratch resistance, and electrochemical corrosion.
evidence_signal: WC–Co–Cr achieved 1232.55 HV and a friction coefficient of 0.515, while porosity was lowest for WC–Ni (0.40%) and highest for WC–NiCr (2.78%).
watch_item: Corrosion results in 3.5 wt.% NaCl do not establish long-term performance under combined wear and corrosion in operating valves.
paper_title: Impact Of Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr binder systems on the microstructure and functional properties of WC coatings produced by detonation spraying
